description: This file defines the ShellDbTablesInfo class which implements ISchemaBuilder to manage database schema operations such as creating, dropping, and modifying tables and indexes within the OrchardCore project, specifically for YesSql database integration.

classes.name: ShellDbTablesInfo
classes.description: A class that manages database schema operations such as creating, dropping, and altering tables and indexes, tailored for YesSql within OrchardCore.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the schema builder with database settings or transaction and logger.

methods.name: GetTableNames
methods.description: Returns a list of all table names managed by this schema builder.

methods.name: CreateMapIndexTable
methods.description: Creates a map index table and associated document table.

methods.name: CreateReduceIndexTable
methods.description: Creates a reduce index table, document table, and bridge table.

methods.name: CreateTable
methods.description: Creates a new table with the specified name.

methods.name: AlterIndexTable
methods.description: Placeholder for altering an index table (no implementation).

methods.name: AlterTable
methods.description: Placeholder for altering a table (no implementation).

methods.name: DropMapIndexTable
methods.description: Drops a map index table.

methods.name: DropReduceIndexTable
methods.description: Drops a reduce index table and related tables.

methods.name: DropTable
methods.description: Drops a table by name.

methods.name: RemoveAllTables
methods.description: Removes all managed tables and index tables.

methods.name: RemoveMapIndexTables
methods.description: Removes all map index tables.

methods.name: RemoveReduceIndexTables
methods.description: Removes all reduce index tables and bridge tables.

methods.name: RemoveDocumentTables
methods.description: Removes all document tables including the main document table.

methods.name: RemoveTables
methods.description: Removes all tables listed in the Tables set.

methods.name: RemoveTable
methods.description: Removes a specific table by executing a drop command.

methods.name: CreateForeignKey
methods.description: Placeholder for creating a foreign key (no implementation).

methods.name: DropForeignKey
methods.description: Drops a foreign key constraint from a table.

methods.name: CreateSchema
methods.description: Placeholder for creating a schema (no implementation).

methods.name: CreateSchemaAsync
methods.description: Async placeholder for creating a schema.
